name: Gala Relax
summary:
Your quiet place, one scene away.

Gala Relax, rebuilt for Meta Quest, puts you inside calming views: waves rolling onto a Hawaiian beach, waterfalls, city skylines at dusk, coral reefs, the coastline from the air. Each scene wraps all around you and loops without a seam, so you can stay as long as you need.

- Seven collections, plus 3D scenes with real depth
- Download your favorites and unwind offline
- Seated or standing, no motion, nothing to learn
- Touch controllers
